nodes.label: Verification Email (OTP)
nodes.rationale: Transactional email that displays a 6-digit OTP to confirm the user's email before publishing reviews. Code expires in 10 minutes; includes anti-phishing guidance (ignore if not requested, never share the code). Table-based layout with inline styles and MSO fallback for email-client compatibility; uses the app's teal (#08705B) brand accent.
